mapper.select: SELECT a.FACTORY_CODE, a.PRODUCT_CODE, mpi.PRODUCT_DESC FROM (SELECT mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE, mhsq.FACTORY_CODE FROM t_mp_history_sale_qty mhsq WHERE IFNULL( mhsq.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND (mhsq.`YEAR` > #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OR (mhsq.`YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mhsq.`MONTH` >= #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) ) AND IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) >= 0 AND mhsq.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE,mhsq.FACTORY_CODE HAVING SUM( IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) ) > #{saleTotalQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL}) a LEFT JOIN t_mdm_min_prod mmp ON mmp.FACTORY_CODE = a.FACTORY_CODE AND mmp.PRODUCT_CODE = a.PRODUCT_CODE LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_info mpi ON mpi.FACTORY_CODE = a.FACTORY_CODE AND mpi.PRODUCT_CODE = a.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE mmp.PRODUCT_CODE is null AND mmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_mdm_min_prod mmp INNER JOIN (SELECT mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE, mhsq.FACTORY_CODE FROM t_mp_history_sale_qty mhsq WHERE IFNULL( mhsq.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND (mhsq.`YEAR` > #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OR (mhsq.`YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mhsq.`MONTH` >= #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) ) AND IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) >= 0 AND mhsq.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE,mhsq.FACTORY_CODE HAVING SUM( IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) ) > #{saleTotalQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) HSC ON mmp.PRODUCT_CODE = HSC.PRODUCT_CODE AND mmp.FACTORY_CODE = HSC.FACTORY_CODE SET mmp.UP_QTY = 1 WHERE mmp.PRODUCT_CODE <> '*' AND mmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE t_mdm_min_prod mmp INNER JOIN (SELECT mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE, mhsq.FACTORY_CODE FROM t_mp_history_sale_qty mhsq WHERE IFNULL( mhsq.IS_DELETE, 0 ) = 0 AND (mhsq.`YEAR` > #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OR (mhsq.`YEAR` = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mhsq.`MONTH` >= #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) ) AND IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) >= 0 AND mhsq.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE,mhsq.FACTORY_CODE HAVING SUM( IFNULL( mhsq.SALE_QTY, 0 ) ) <= #{saleTotalQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ) HSC ON mmp.PRODUCT_CODE = HSC.PRODUCT_CODE AND mmp.FACTORY_CODE = HSC.FACTORY_CODE SET mmp.UP_QTY = #{defaultQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} WHERE mmp.PRODUCT_CODE <> '*' AND mmp.UP_QTY = 1 AND mmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE t_mp_month_sale_plan msp JOIN t_mdm_product_info mpi ON msp.FACTORY_CODE = mpi.FACTORY_CODE AND msp.PRODUCT_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(mpi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 SET msp.PRODUCT_DESC = mpi.PRODUCT_DESC, msp.PRO_SIZE = mpi.PRO_SIZE, msp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, msp.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME = mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, msp.SPECIFICATIONS = mpi.SPECIFICATIONS, msp.PATTERN = mpi.PATTERN, msp.BRAND = mpi.BRAND, msp.COMMON_TYPE= mpi.COMMON_TYPE, msp.TIRE_TYPE = mpi.TIRE_TYPE, msp.HIERARCHY = mpi.HIERARCHY WHERE msp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND msp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND msp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL}

UPDATE t_mp_month_sale_plan msp JOIN t_out_month_sale_plan omsp ON msp.FACTORY_CODE = omsp.FACTORY_CODE AND msp.YEAR = omsp.YEAR AND msp.MONTH = omsp.MONTH AND msp.ORDER_NO = omsp.ORDER_NO AND msp.CUSTOM_CODE = omsp.CUSTOM_CODE AND msp.LOCATION_TYPE = omsp.LOCATION_TYPE AND msp.CHANNEL = omsp.CHANNEL AND msp.PRODUCT_CODE = omsp.PRODUCT_CODE SET msp.PRODUCT_DESC = omsp.PRODUCT_DESC, msp.PRO_SIZE = omsp.PRO_SIZE, msp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = omsp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, msp.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME = omsp.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, msp.SPECIFICATIONS = omsp.SPECIFICATIONS, msp.PATTERN = omsp.PATTERN, msp.BRAND = omsp.BRAND, msp.COMMON_TYPE= omsp.COMMON_TYPE, msp.TIRE_TYPE = omsp.TIRE_TYPE, msp.HIERARCHY = omsp.HIERARCHY, msp.PLAN_QTY = omsp.PLAN_QTY WHERE ISNULL(msp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_mp_month_sale_plan (FACTORY_CODE, ORDER_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, CUSTOM_CODE, CUSTOM_NAME, YEAR, MONTH, LOCATION_TYPE, CHANNEL, BRAND, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_DESC, PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, PRO_SIZE, SPECIFICATIONS, PATTERN, HIERARCHY, TIRE_TYPE, COMMON_TYPE, PLAN_QTY, TRADE_MODE, SALE_PERSON, IS_IMPORTANT_CUSTOM, IS_ENSURE_PLAN, IS_EMERGENCY, CONTRACT_NO, NATION, SUBMISSION_DATE, DELIVERY_DATE_DUE, REMARK, IS_DELETE, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY) SELECT FACTORY_CODE, ORDER_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, CUSTOM_CODE, CUSTOM_NAME, YEAR, MONTH, LOCATION_TYPE, CHANNEL, BRAND, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_DESC, PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, PRO_SIZE, SPECIFICATIONS, PATTERN, HIERARCHY, TIRE_TYPE, COMMON_TYPE, PLAN_QTY, TRADE_MODE, SALE_PERSON, IS_IMPORTANT_CUSTOM, IS_ENSURE_PLAN, IS_EMERGENCY, CONTRACT_NO, NATION, SUBMISSION_DATE, DELIVERY_DATE_DUE, REMARK, IS_DELETE, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY FROM t_out_month_sale_plan
